data.history_note: Top-ten fantasy defenses with their scoring components, 2021-2024, transcribed from the operator's screenshots of a scoring table. Not in the workbook. Verified two ways before use: every row falls in a plausible range and is correctly ordered by points per game, and reconstructing season points from the components leaves a residual that tracks opponent points per game at r = -0.88, which is what a points-allowed tier does. A misread digit would break that.
